nom: BOBBI BROWN Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ Moisturizer & Primer with Vitamin C + Hyaluronic Acid

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls it a 'dry skin savior' after years of foundation clinging to flaking, cracking patches, report it relieves dryness effectively, though one notes very dry skin may still need an extra layer of moisturizer in winter.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin have mixed results: one says it balances her oily and dry patches without bothering her acne, while another whose skin leans combination reports occasional small breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, rosacea-prone skin report no irritation or reaction despite the product's noticeable fragrance, even in a hot, dry climate that normally aggravates their rosacea.
segments.oily: Reviewers disagree on oily skin: one with an oily T-zone says it kept her face matte and shine-free all day, while another states plainly that it is not good for oily skin.

concerns.dehydration: The overwhelming majority of reviewers, including several with dry skin, report significant, lasting hydration and relief from dry patches or flaking; a couple disagree, saying it did not provide enough hydration for their skin or that very dry skin may need an extra layer in winter.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some managing acne-prone or combination skin, say the formula does not trigger breakouts or flare-ups; two disagree, one reporting new whitehead breakouts she attributes to the reformulated niacinamide, and another noting occasional small breakouts as her skin leans more combination.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers disagree on oil control: one with an oily T-zone says it kept her face matte and shine-free all day, while another states plainly that the product is not good for oily skin.
concerns.aging: One reviewer says the product seems to soften the look of fine lines while it is being worn, though this is a single, temporary-effect report rather than a broader trend across reviews.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the formula's vitamin content with supporting her skin barrier, though no other reviewer discusses barrier effects specifically.

aspects.libelle: Rich, balmy texture that settles after minutes
Doubles as moisturizer and primer in one step
Strong citrus scent, too much for some
Premium price for the jar size
A little product goes a long way

extraits.texte: I've loved and used the original formula for probably 15+ years. It was the best and nothing compared. I was always afraid this day would come that they'd ruin a great thing, at least for me. I figured I'd give the new formula a try before I cast any judgement but as soon as I saw the addition of niacinamide - which why is it in everything now when people have reactions too it - I was bummed since I am one of those people who get tiny white head breakouts no matter the concentration. So disappointed to have to find a new product. Also the cap is now a cheaper plastic and the formula seems more greasy and didn't sit well under my makeup like the original. Even if it wasn't for the niacinamide and my personal issue with it, I don't think the reformulation is better and anyone who says it is, was probably gifted the product for their review.

extraits.titre: Worth the splurge for magic in a jar!
extraits.texte: I was excited to try this product because I'd heard so many great things about it but hadn't purchased it because of the price. After testing it, I can confidently say that for me, it's worth the splurge. I'm 43 with fair-to-light, very sensitive, dry skin and rosacea. I also live in a hot, dry climate where temperatures frequently exceed 100°,and heat & sweating can aggravate my rosacea. I've tried countless primers & setting sprays promising long-lasting, sweat-resistant wear, but I've never found one that kept my makeup looking fresh for more than a few hours without being overly matte & drying. This product impressed me immediately. It has a light citrus scent, but despite my sensitivity to fragrance, it caused no irritation & the scent quickly disappeared. The consistency is somewhat thick but feels luxurious rather than heavy. It absorbs quickly, leaves no stickiness or residue, & didn't cause any pilling. My skin felt soft, smooth & moisturized without feeling oily. My makeup applied beautifully over it, blending smoothly while still having enough grip to adhere well. I didn't experience the creasing or caking I sometimes get around my eyes from dry skin, & my skin felt hydrated enough that I could skip my usual extra moisturizing & eye-primer steps. I used only a few mists of setting spray so I could really test the primer's staying power. I was extremely impressed! My makeup stayed in place better than with any other primer I've tried. I liked the texture it is somewhat like a balm and can be layered depending on how dry your skin in I usually start out with a tiny amount and add more in areas where my skin is drier after I pre prep my skin. It does work well and has some slip to it without feeling greasy. My makeup stays on with a bit of setting spray and I don't have to use as much misting spray during the day for my skin feel hydrated. My only complaint is that when my skin is less dry and leaning towards combination it does give me the occasional small breakout.**** Disclaimer: I received this product for free from Bobbi Brown for testing and reviewing purposes.*****

I'm telling you that's my first time using this my makeup looked so good. I was amazed. My makeup just looks so much better. The product itself has a thick, somewhat thick consistency. It blends in nicely and has a light citrus sent you barely need any other product. I'm telling you I would buy this product over and over again and recommended to all my friends and family. My only downside is I would have to say it is not good for people with oily skin I received this product for free from Bobby Brown for testing and review purposes, but these are my honest opinions

I love how this acts as both a moisturizer and a primer, which saves me so much time by replacing a step in my routine rather than adding one. The texture is rich and cushiony and absorbs into my skin quickly so it feels hydrated instead of greasy. My T-zone gets oily within one to two hours, even with powder but this kept my face matte, fresh, and shine-free all day! I received this product for free from Bobbi Brown for testing and review purposes.

I have struggled for years with foundation clinging to dry patches and cracking around smile lines. Adding this rich, weightless cream to my morning routine, completely changed the game. This moisturizing primer soaks right into my skin without leaving heavy film. As both my daytime, moisturizer and primer keeps my face looking Dewey and fresh. I received this product for free from Bobby Brown for testing and review purposes only.

extraits.titre: Love face base by Bobby brown
extraits.texte: I really enjoyed this face base, ive always heard good things about it but anymore stuff is so overhyped. I was given the chance to review it honestly. Felt very smooth going on left a good base to apply my makeup, the smell is pleasing and nit over powering. I have combination skin type so occasionally dry patches and I get oily at the end of the day. This gave me a balance for my skin problems. Didnt seem to bother my acne which is nice or make me have a flare up. I really enjoyed it and cant wait to see how it holds up and if it helps my skin overtime. It definitely noticed my makeup held up, laying evenly. I rather enjoyed it and very pleased with it. I received this product for free from Bobbi Brown for testing and review purposes.
